skill.name: higgsfield-generate
skill.description: Generate and edit images, videos, 3D assets, and audio through Higgsfield, including Marketing Studio ads and video virality analysis.
skill.summary: Route creative requests to Higgsfield models and return generated media or analysis results.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: One critical finding is confirmed: the bootstrap pipes a mutable remote installer directly into sh. The other 175 alerts are Markdown, documentation, fixed CLI examples, placeholders, or safe temporary-file usage. No prompt injection or covert exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap executes a remote installer without verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a released installer, verify its checksum or signature, and inspect it before execution. Require user confirmation before running the verified local file.

content.value_statement: Creative media production requires compatible models, inputs, and parameters. This skill routes requests through Higgsfield and returns media, 3D assets, audio, or video analysis.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable Higgsfield models for image, video, 3D, audio, advertising, and video analysis tasks.
Generates images from prompts and optional reference images with model-specific aspect ratios and resolutions.
Generates or edits video from prompts, images, source video, audio, sketches, and reframe instructions.
Creates textured 3D assets from one to four reference images.
Builds branded ads with Marketing Studio products, avatars, brand kits, formats, hooks, and settings.
Scores finished videos for hook strength, attention, retention, and virality potential.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and sufficient service credits.
Does not train Soul Characters or create specialized product photoshoots and marketplace listing cards.
Available models, parameters, processing time, and output quality depend on Higgsfield services.
Unsupported external video links must be supplied as local files before use.

use_cases.title: Produce Social Media Creative
use_cases.description: Create vertical images, short videos, sound effects, and campaign variations from a concise brief.

use_cases.title: Build Branded Advertisements
use_cases.description: Combine approved products, presenters, brand kits, and ad formats for consistent campaign assets.

use_cases.title: Prototype Multimedia Assets
use_cases.description: Turn reference images into 3D assets or evaluate finished videos before a production decision.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 image of [subject] in [style]. Use clear lighting and return the final media link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a direct image request.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [image path] into a [duration]-second [aspect ratio] video. Use [camera motion] and preserve the subject appearance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create video from one supplied image.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Branded Ad
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second ad for [product URL or product ID]. Show available ad formats first, then use my selected format and presenter.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a Marketing Studio campaign asset.

prompt_templates.title: Run an Advanced Creative Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Reframe [video path] to [aspect ratio] at [resolution]. Then analyze the result for hook strength, attention, retention, and virality potential.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine video transformation and business analysis.

output_examples.input: Create a square packaging concept for a citrus drink with clear label text.
output_examples.output: Generated a 2K square packaging concept with GPT Image 2. The final media link is ready.

output_examples.input: Turn my landscape clip into a vertical social video at 720p.
output_examples.output: Reframed the source video to 9:16 at 720p. The completed video link is ready.

output_examples.input: Analyze this finished advertisement for attention and retention.
output_examples.output: Virality analysis completed. The response includes the overall score, peak hook second, sustain score, key regions, and visual report link.

best_practices: Specify the medium, subject, style, aspect ratio, duration, and resolution when these details matter.
Use only media and brand assets that you are authorized to upload and transform.
Request a cost estimate before submission when budget or batch size matters.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for Soul Character training or specialized product photoshoots.
Do not combine an ad reference with Marketing Studio hooks or settings in one generation.
Do not submit private media, restricted trademarks, public-figure likenesses, or sexual content.

faq.question: What media can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create images, videos, 3D assets, audio, branded advertisements, and text reports from video analysis.

faq.question: Does it require a Higgsfield account?
faq.answer: Yes. The Higgsfield CLI must be installed and authenticated, and generation may consume account credits.

faq.question: Can I provide reference media?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported models accept local files or existing Higgsfield upload and job identifiers.

faq.question: How does it select a model?
faq.answer: It maps the requested medium, style, references, quality, and workflow to a compatible Higgsfield model.

faq.question: Can it create branded marketing content?
faq.answer: Yes. Marketing Studio supports products, avatars, brand kits, ad formats, hooks, settings, and reference videos.

faq.question: Can it estimate cost before generation?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for an estimate, and the skill can query Higgsfield cost commands before submitting supported jobs.
